title: FPVGate C5MK AIO 8-Pilot FPV Lap Timer
description: All-in-one FPV lap timer for up to eight pilots. Detects gate crossings from the 5.8 GHz video signal without transponders. Connect over Wi-Fi or USB to configure channels, run heats, and review race results. Supports RotorHazard via the FPVGate plugin.
